references.text: Kedemoth and Mephaath are also mentioned in the list of Levitical cities given to the sons of Merari from the tribe of Reuben.
1 Chronicles repeats the list of Levitical cities, including the four cities given to the Merarites from the tribe of Reuben.
Kedemoth is mentioned as one of the cities of refuge in the wilderness on the plain in the territory of Reuben.
Mephaath is mentioned as a city in Moab in Jeremiah's prophecy concerning judgment over Moab.
